name: video-render
title: Video render
description: A timeline as one FFmpeg command: an input per clip, each picture fitted, looked, faded and laid over the background at its time, each sound retimed, levelled, faded, delayed and mixed, then MP4 (MPEG-4 + AAC), WebM (VP8 + Opus), GIF, MP3 or WAV. renderTimeline runs it with progress.
